instruction: nRF52840 Pinmux Correction The file design.kicad_sch is a KiCad 10.0.2 schematic for a Nordic nRF52840 design. Start KiCad with `/usr/bin/kicad`; the board and schematic editors are also available directly at `/usr/bin/pcbnew` and `/usr/bin/eeschema`. The symbol U1 has hidden properties encoding GPIO pad assignments for five peripherals: QSPI, SPI0, TWI0, UART0, and PWM0. A reference CSV is at /home/user/Desktop/pinmux_initial.csv. Reassign the peripheral pad properties so that all pinmux rules are satisfied. Write the corrected schematic as /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_sch. Requirements: 1. QSPI pins (SCK, CSN, IO0, IO1, IO2, IO3) must all be assigned to pads in the range P0.17..P0.25. 2. SPI0 pins must NOT be on any pad in the QSPI-dedicated range P0.17..P0.25. 3. All pads must be valid nRF52840 GPIO pads (P0.00..P0.47 or P1.00..P1.15). 4. No GPIO pad may be assigned to more than one peripheral function. 5. All 5 peripherals must retain their full set of functions (no function may be removed). 6. Only the pad assignment property values may change; all other schematic content must remain intact. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_sch.
